Deliver patch-1 (object obj-c567f5b9c7d905481548e89b, v2, files_sha256 e22878e735...).

Issue: stack casts int32 dtype coordinate to int64 (GH #7376).

Root cause: PandasMultiIndexingAdapter.__array__ returned
self.array.get_level_values(self.level).values for level-backed arrays.
pandas' .values accessor promotes int32 level values to int64, so the
MultiIndex level variable built during stack() lost the original i4 dtype.

Fix (xarray/core/indexes.py -> actually xarray/core/indexing.py, single file):
level values are now converted via np.asarray(array, dtype=self.dtype) when no
explicit dtype is requested, so stack/unstack preserve the source coordinate
dtype.

stack/MultiIndex selections across test_indexes.py, test_dataset.py and
test_dataarray.py 67 passed; 0 failed, 0 errors, validation_status verified.

def test_stack(self) -> None:
        ds = Dataset(
            data_vars={"b": (("x", "y"), [[0, 1], [2, 3]])},
            coords={"x": ("x", [0, 1]), "y": ["a", "b"]},
        )

        exp_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([[0, 1], ["a", "b"]], names=["x", "y"])
        expected = Dataset(
            data_vars={"b": ("z", [0, 1, 2, 3])},
            coords={"z": exp_index},
        )
        # check attrs propagated
        ds["x"].attrs["foo"] = "bar"
        expected["x"].attrs["foo"] = "bar"

        actual = ds.stack(z=["x", "y"])
        assert_identical(expected, actual)
        assert list(actual.xindexes) == ["z", "x", "y"]

        actual = ds.stack(z=[...])
        assert_identical(expected, actual)

        # non list dims with ellipsis
        actual = ds.stack(z=(...,))
        assert_identical(expected, actual)

        # ellipsis with given dim
        actual = ds.stack(z=[..., "y"])
        assert_identical(expected, actual)

        exp_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([["a", "b"], [0, 1]], names=["y", "x"])
        expected = Dataset(
            data_vars={"b": ("z", [0, 2, 1, 3])},
            coords={"z": exp_index},
        )
        expected["x"].attrs["foo"] = "bar"

        actual = ds.stack(z=["y", "x"])
        assert_identical(expected, actual)
        assert list(actual.xindexes) == ["z", "y", "x"]

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "create_index,expected_keys",
        [
            (True, ["z", "x", "y"]),
            (False, []),
            (None, ["z", "x", "y"]),
        ],
    )

explicit dtype is requested, so stack / MultiIndex construction preserves the
source coordinate dtype.
